title: Tolerances
summary: Frozen record of every JAOS solver and checker tolerance, where each acts, what it decides, and the instance evidence behind the freeze.
notes: Type taken from manifest (DOC, precedence 3); heuristic classification skipped. Content carries SPEC-shaped signals — constant/value tables and checker formulas — but the manifest declaration is authoritative. Cites decision IDs D17-D91 as external references rather than making decisions itself.
